verdict.rationale: Anrok's marketing shows international coverage: a world exposure map with a UK registration threshold tracker, obligations tracked across 13 countries, and registration completed in 13 jurisdictions. It also returns valid tax IDs per jurisdiction, and the pricing page claims early alerts plus filing, payments and registration in every jurisdiction. However, nothing explicitly confirms EU OSS/IOSS, Canadian or Australian GST, or that foreign VAT returns are filed, and most of this comes from dashboard image captions and pricing bullets. Missing for 10: explicit EU OSS/IOSS support, named Canada/Australia GST coverage, documented foreign VAT/GST filing, in-depth docs and independent corroboration of international coverage.
